description:
Review of wave 1 (spec defk-juw): no test triggers defk_lost_resume's RuntimeError; only the 10 s backstop is covered. Add a test that a missing/wrong resume dispatch raises 'defk bug: kernel resumed at safepoint ...' quickly, without adding a production-facing option (e.g. a test-only hook gated on Mix.env/test compile, or compiling a kernel through Defk.Compiler with a test-only flag that drops one dispatch case). Also exercise the 'returned without reaching it' path if feasible.

Done when the test fails if the check is removed from the runtime.
title: Test the lost-resume error message
